name: Satsuki to Dan no Atarashii Sekai
original_name: サツキとダンの新しい世界
source:
Don't you want to enjoy love in another universe?
Satsuki takes a trip to the parallel world and slips on the delicate conversation with soldier Dan... a love story.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ081895.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你不想在另一个宇宙享受爱情吗？
小月前往平行世界，与士兵丹进行了微妙的对话……一个爱情故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ081895.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
